name: msa-family-feud
description: MSA Family Feud: projector game board, host panel, audience survey, and phone buzzers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @feud/server" "npm run dev -w @feud/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @feud/web
scripts.event: npm run build && node --no-warnings=ExperimentalWarning --import tsx scripts/event.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web && tsc --noEmit -p scripts && tsc --noEmit -p e2e
